segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I had us down to confirm the seat count and target go-live for the analytics workspace. Is 48 named users still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It is 48 for launch. We may add another 10 in Q3, but finance only approved the 48 right now.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. At 48 seats on the annual plan, you're at $42 per user per month, so $24,192 for the year. That includes the standard onboarding package and SSO.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the start date would be March 1? We need invoices to line up with our new cost center.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: March 1 works. First invoice would issue March 1, net 30, and the term would run through February 28, 2027. I can put the cost center field on the order form if you send me the code.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, it's OPS-7142. Also, can you confirm the kickoff timing? Our admin, Priya, is out the week of March 10.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Good catch. If we get signature by February 20, we can do kickoff March 4, admin training March 6, and then end-user rollout March 18. That avoids Priya's PTO.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That timeline is fine. Legal had one question on auto-renewal. We prefer 30 days' notice instead of 60.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That's within our standard terms for mid-market agreements. I'll set non-renewal notice to 30 days in the order form and the contract language will match.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send it over today if you can, and I'll route it to our controller.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You'll have the order form this afternoon with 48 seats, $24,192 annual total, March 1 start, net 30, and the rollout dates we just covered.
